info.name: iNKORE.UI.WPF.Modern
info.description: Modern (Fluent 2) styles and controls for WPF applications

setup.app_xaml_full:
<Application.Resources>
    <ResourceDictionary>
        <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
            <ui:ThemeResources>
                <ui:ThemeResources.ThemeDictionaries>
                    <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Light" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="Light">
                        <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                            <presets:ColorPresetResources TargetTheme="Light" />
                            <presets:ShapePresetResources />
                        </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                    </ResourceDictionary>
                    <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Dark" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="Dark">
                        <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                            <presets:ColorPresetResources TargetTheme="Dark" />
                            <presets:ShapePresetResources />
                        </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                    </ResourceDictionary>
                    <ResourceDictionary x:Key="HighContrast" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="HighContrast">
                        <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                            <ResourceDictionary Source="/Themes/HighContrast.xaml" />
                        </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                    </ResourceDictionary>
                </ui:ThemeResources.ThemeDictionaries>
            </ui:ThemeResources>
            <ui:XamlControlsResources />
        </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
    </ResourceDictionary>
</Application.Resources>

SimpleStackPanel.description: 增强版 StackPanel，支持 Spacing 属性控制子元素间距。来自 iNKORE.UI.WPF 库。

properties.Orientation: 排列方向: Vertical (默认) 或 Horizontal

snippets.title: 基础用法
snippets.code:
<ikw:SimpleStackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="5">
    <TextBlock Text="Fluent Design is beautiful." FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" TextAlignment="Center"/>
    <TextBlock Text="But hey, we deserve it :-)" FontSize="20" TextAlignment="Center"/>
    <Button Content="Hello world!" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,20,0,0"/>
</ikw:SimpleStackPanel>

snippets.title: 带 Orientation 和 Spacing
snippets.code:
<ikw:SimpleStackPanel x:Name="Control1" Spacing="8"
    VerticalAlignment="Top" Orientation="Vertical" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
    <ikw:SimpleStackPanel.Resources>
        <Style TargetType="Rectangle">
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="40" />
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="40" />
        </Style>
    </ikw:SimpleStackPanel.Resources>
    <Rectangle Fill="Red" />
    <Rectangle Fill="Blue" />
    <Rectangle Fill="Green" />
    <Rectangle Fill="Yellow" />
</ikw:SimpleStackPanel>

snippets.title: 作为页面内容容器 (带样式)
snippets.code:
<ikw:SimpleStackPanel Style="{StaticResource ControlPageContentPanelStyle}">
    <!-- 页面内容 -->
</ikw:SimpleStackPanel>
snippets.source: Gallery App.xaml 中定义的 ControlPageContentPanelStyle

Button.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
Button.description: 按钮控件，自动应用 Fluent 2 样式。支持 AccentButtonStyleKey 来设置强调色按钮。

snippets.title: 简单按钮
snippets.code: <Button Content="Standard XAML button" Click="Button_Click" />

snippets.title: 带图片内容的按钮
snippets.code:
<Button Width="50" Height="50" AutomationProperties.Name="Pie" Click="Button_Click">
    <Image AutomationProperties.Name="Slice" Source="/Assets/Slices.png" />
</Button>

snippets.title: 强调色按钮 (Accent Style)
snippets.code: <Button Content="Accent style button" Style="{DynamicResource {x:Static ui:ThemeKeys.AccentButtonStyleKey}}" />

snippets.title: 自动换行的按钮
snippets.code:
<Button MaxWidth="240" Margin="0,0,8,0">
    <TextBlock Text="This is some text that is too long and will get cut off" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
</Button>

TextBox.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
TextBox.description: 文本框控件，通过 ui:ControlHelper 附加属性设置 Header 和 PlaceholderText。

snippets.title: 简单文本框
snippets.code: <TextBox AutomationProperties.Name="simple TextBox" />

snippets.title: 带标题和占位符的文本框
snippets.code: <TextBox ui:ControlHelper.Header="Enter your name:" ui:ControlHelper.PlaceholderText="Name" />

snippets.title: 只读多行文本框 (带拼写检查)
snippets.code:
<TextBox AcceptsReturn="True"
    AutomationProperties.Name="multi-line TextBox"
    SelectionBrush="Green"
    SpellCheck.IsEnabled="True"
    TextWrapping="Wrap" />

snippets.title: 自定义样式的只读文本框
snippets.code:
<TextBox AutomationProperties.Name="customized TextBox"
    FontFamily="Arial" FontSize="24"
    FontStyle="Italic" IsReadOnly="True"
    Foreground="CornflowerBlue"
    Text="I am super excited to be here!" />

CheckBox.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
CheckBox.description: 复选框控件，支持两态和三态模式。

snippets.title: 两态复选框
snippets.code:
<CheckBox Content="Two-state CheckBox"
    Checked="Control1_Checked"
    Unchecked="Control1_Unchecked" />

snippets.title: 三态复选框
snippets.code:
<CheckBox Content="Three-state CheckBox"
    IsThreeState="True"
    Checked="Control2_Checked"
    Indeterminate="Control2_Indeterminate"
    Unchecked="Control2_Unchecked" />

snippets.title: 全选复选框 (三态联动)
snippets.code:
<CheckBox x:Name="OptionsAllCheckBox"
    Content="Select all"
    IsThreeState="True"
    Checked="SelectAll_Checked"
    Indeterminate="SelectAll_Indeterminate"
    Unchecked="SelectAll_Unchecked" />
<CheckBox x:Name="Option1CheckBox"
    Margin="24,0,0,0"
    Content="Option 1"
    Checked="Option_Checked"
    Unchecked="Option_Unchecked" />

ComboBox.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
ComboBox.description: 下拉框控件，通过 ui:ControlHelper 设置 Header 和 PlaceholderText。

snippets.title: 内联项 ComboBox
snippets.code:
<ComboBox x:Name="Combo1" Width="200"
    ui:ControlHelper.Header="Colors"
    ui:ControlHelper.PlaceholderText="Pick a color"
    SelectionChanged="ColorComboBox_SelectionChanged">
    <sys:String>Blue</sys:String>
    <sys:String>Green</sys:String>
    <sys:String>Red</sys:String>
    <sys:String>Yellow</sys:String>
</ComboBox>

snippets.title: 可编辑 ComboBox
snippets.code:
<ComboBox x:Name="Combo3" Width="200"
    ui:ControlHelper.Header="Font Size"
    IsEditable="True"
    ItemsSource="{Binding FontSizes}"
    Loaded="Combo3_Loaded" />

RadioButtons.description: 单选按钮组控件，比原生 RadioButton 更方便管理分组。

snippets.title: 单选按钮组
snippets.code:
<ui:RadioButtons Header="Options:">
    <RadioButton Content="Option 1" Checked="RadioButton_Checked" />
    <RadioButton Content="Option 2" Checked="RadioButton_Checked" />
    <RadioButton Content="Option 3" Checked="RadioButton_Checked" />
</ui:RadioButtons>

snippets.title: 绑定枚举的单选按钮组
snippets.code:
<ui:RadioButtons Header="Orientation"
    ItemsSource="{Binding Source={x:Type Orientation}, Converter={StaticResource EnumValuesConverter}}"
    SelectedItem="{Binding ElementName=slider, Path=Orientation}" 
    SelectionChanged="RadioButtons_SelectionChanged"/>

Slider.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
Slider.description: 滑块控件，自动应用 Fluent 2 样式。

snippets.title: 简单滑块
snippets.code: <Slider x:Name="Slider1" Width="200" AutomationProperties.Name="simple slider" />

snippets.title: 带范围和步进的滑块
snippets.code:
<Slider x:Name="Slider2" Width="200"
    ui:ControlHelper.Header="Control header"
    Maximum="1000" Minimum="500"
    SmallChange="10" TickFrequency="10"
    Value="800" />

snippets.title: 带刻度标记的滑块
snippets.code:
<Slider x:Name="Slider3" Width="290"
    AutomationProperties.Name="Slider with ticks"
    TickFrequency="20" TickPlacement="Both" />

snippets.title: 垂直滑块
snippets.code:
<Slider x:Name="Slider4" Width="100" Height="100"
    AutomationProperties.Name="vertical slider"
    Maximum="50" Minimum="-50"
    Orientation="Vertical"
    TickFrequency="10" TickPlacement="Both" />

ProgressBar.description: 进度条控件，支持确定和不确定模式，以及错误/暂停状态。

snippets.title: 不确定进度条
snippets.code:
<ui:ProgressBar x:Name="ProgressBar1" Width="130"
    IsIndeterminate="True"
    ShowError="{Binding IsChecked, ElementName=ErrorRB}"
    ShowPaused="{Binding IsChecked, ElementName=PausedRB}" />

snippets.title: 确定进度条
snippets.code:
<ProgressBar x:Name="ProgressBar2" Width="130"
    Value="{Binding ElementName=ProgressValue, Path=Value, Mode=OneWay}" />

snippets.title: 进度环
snippets.code:
<ui:ProgressRing x:Name="ProgressRing1" Width="60" Height="60"
    IsActive="{Binding IsOn, ElementName=ProgressToggle}" />

ToggleSwitch.description: 切换开关控件，支持自定义 Header、OnContent、OffContent。

snippets.title: 简单切换开关
snippets.code: <ui:ToggleSwitch AutomationProperties.Name="simple ToggleSwitch" />

snippets.title: 带自定义内容的切换开关
snippets.code:
<ui:ToggleSwitch x:Name="toggleSwitch"
    Header="Toggle work" IsOn="True"
    OffContent="Do work" OnContent="Working"
    VerticalAlignment="Top" />

snippets.title: 与 ProgressRing 联动
snippets.code:
<StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Top" Orientation="Horizontal">
    <ui:ToggleSwitch x:Name="toggleSwitch"
        Header="Toggle work" IsOn="True"
        OffContent="Do work" OnContent="Working" VerticalAlignment="Top" />
    <ui:ProgressRing Width="32" IsActive="{Binding IsOn, ElementName=toggleSwitch}" />
</StackPanel>

Expander.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
Expander.description: 展开折叠控件，支持 Card 样式和自定义内容对齐。

snippets.title: 基本展开器
snippets.code:
<Expander x:Name="Expander1" VerticalAlignment="Top"
    Content="This is in the content"
    ExpandDirection="Down" IsExpanded="False">
    <Expander.Header>
        <TextBlock Text="This text is in the header" FontWeight="Bold" />
    </Expander.Header>
</Expander>

snippets.title: Card 样式展开器
snippets.code:
<Expander x:Name="Expander4" VerticalAlignment="Top"
    Content="This is in the content"
    Style="{StaticResource {x:Static ui:ThemeKeys.ExpanderCardStyleKey}}"
    ExpandDirection="Down" IsExpanded="False">
    <Expander.Header>
        <TextBlock Text="This text is in the header" FontWeight="Bold" />
    </Expander.Header>
</Expander>

snippets.title: 带自定义控件的展开器
snippets.code:
<Expander x:Name="Expander2">
    <Expander.Header>
        <ToggleButton Content="This is a ToggleButton in the header" />
    </Expander.Header>
    <Expander.Content>
        <Grid>
            <Button Margin="15" Content="This is a Button in the content" />
        </Grid>
    </Expander.Content>
</Expander>

InfoBar.description: 信息栏控件，支持多种严重级别 (Informational/Success/Warning/Error)，可关闭，可带图标和操作按钮。

snippets.title: 基本信息栏
snippets.code:
<ui:InfoBar x:Name="TestInfoBar1"
    Title="Title"
    IsOpen="True"
    Message="Essential app message for your users to be informed of, acknowledge, or take action on."
    Severity="Informational" 
    Closed="InfoBar_Closed"/>

snippets.title: 带图标和关闭按钮的信息栏
snippets.code:
<ui:InfoBar x:Name="TestInfoBar3"
    Title="Title"
    IsClosable="True"
    IsIconVisible="True"
    IsOpen="True"
    Message="Essential app message for your users to be informed of, acknowledge, or take action on." />

NumberBox.description: 数字输入框控件，支持表达式计算、微调按钮、格式化等。

snippets.title: 支持表达式的 NumberBox
snippets.code:
<ui:NumberBox
    AcceptsExpression="True"
    Header="Enter an expression:"
    PlaceholderText="1 + 2^2"
    Value="NaN" />

snippets.title: 带微调按钮的 NumberBox
snippets.code:
<ui:NumberBox
    x:Name="NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementExample"
    Header="Enter an integer:"
    LargeChange="100"
    SmallChange="10"
    SpinButtonPlacementMode="Compact"
    Value="10" />

snippets.title: 带范围的 NumberBox
snippets.code:
<ui:NumberBox
    x:Name="NumberBox1"
    Width="200"
    Header="Control header"
    Maximum="100"
    Minimum="0"
    PlaceholderText="A + B"
    SpinButtonPlacementMode="Compact" />

TabControl.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式; 使用 ui:TabControlHelper 附加属性)
TabControl.description: 标签控件，通过 ui:TabControlHelper 提供关闭按钮、TabStripHeader/Footer 等功能。使用 ui:TabItemHelper 设置图标和可关闭性。

snippets.title: 基本 TabControl (带关闭按钮)
snippets.code:
<TabControl x:Name="tabControl" 
    ui:TabControlHelper.TabCloseRequested="tabControl_TabCloseRequested">
    <ui:TabControlHelper.TabStripHeader>
        <Button Content="Header" />
    </ui:TabControlHelper.TabStripHeader>
    <ui:TabControlHelper.TabStripFooter>
        <Button Content="Footer" />
    </ui:TabControlHelper.TabStripFooter>
</TabControl>

snippets.title: 带图标的 TabItem
snippets.code:
<TabControl x:Name="TabView4" MinWidth="490" SelectedIndex="0"
    ui:TabControlHelper.IsAddTabButtonVisible="False"
    ui:TabControlHelper.TabCloseRequested="tabControl_TabCloseRequested">
    <TabControl.Items>
        <TabItem Header="CMD Prompt">
            <ui:TabItemHelper.Icon>
                <ui:BitmapIcon ShowAsMonochrome="False" UriSource="/Assets/TabViewIcons/cmd.png" />
            </ui:TabItemHelper.Icon>
        </TabItem>
        <TabItem Header="Powershell">
            <ui:TabItemHelper.Icon>
                <ui:BitmapIcon ShowAsMonochrome="False" UriSource="/Assets/TabViewIcons/powershell.png" />
            </ui:TabItemHelper.Icon>
        </TabItem>
    </TabControl.Items>
</TabControl>

snippets.title: 带自定义 TabStrip 背景色的 TabControl
snippets.code:
<TabControl x:Name="tabControl3" 
    ui:ThemeManager.HasThemeResources="True"
    ui:TabControlHelper.TabCloseRequested="tabControl_TabCloseRequested">
    <TabControl.Resources>
        <ui:ResourceDictionaryEx>
            <ui:ResourceDictionaryEx.ThemeDictionaries>
                <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Light">
                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="TabViewBackground" Color="{DynamicResource SystemAccentColorLight2}" />
                </ResourceDictionary>
                <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Dark">
                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="TabViewBackground" Color="{DynamicResource SystemAccentColorDark2}" />
                </ResourceDictionary>
            </ui:ResourceDictionaryEx.ThemeDictionaries>
        </ui:ResourceDictionaryEx>
    </TabControl.Resources>
</TabControl>

snippets.title: 自定义 TabItem 样式
snippets.code:
<TabControl x:Name="tabControl2"
    ui:TabControlHelper.TabCloseRequested="tabControl_TabCloseRequested">
    <TabControl.Resources>
        <sys:Double x:Key="TabViewItemHeaderFontSize">24</sys:Double>
        <sys:Double x:Key="TabViewItemHeaderIconSize">32</sys:Double>
    </TabControl.Resources>
    <TabControl.ItemContainerStyle>
        <Style BasedOn="{StaticResource DefaultTabItemStyle}" TargetType="TabItem">
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Courier New" />
        </Style>
    </TabControl.ItemContainerStyle>
</TabControl>

snippets.title: 不可关闭的 TabItem
snippets.code:
<TabItem Header="Unclosable" ui:TabItemHelper.IsClosable="False">
    <TextBlock Text="This tab cannot be closed." />
</TabItem>

Pivot.description: Pivot 控件实际上是通过 TabControl 应用 TabControlPivotStyle 样式实现的，使用 ui:PivotHelper 设置标题。

snippets.title: 基本 Pivot
snippets.code:
<TabControl MinHeight="400"
    ui:PivotHelper.Title="EMAIL"
    Style="{StaticResource TabControlPivotStyle}">
    <TabItem Header="All">
        <TextBlock Text="all emails go here." />
    </TabItem>
    <TabItem Header="Unread">
        <TextBlock Text="unread emails go here." />
    </TabItem>
    <TabItem Header="Flagged">
        <TextBlock Text="flagged emails go here." />
    </TabItem>
</TabControl>

NavigationView.description: 导航视图控件，提供侧边栏导航菜单，支持折叠/展开、图标、Frame 内容区域。

snippets.title: 基本 NavigationView
snippets.code:
<ui:NavigationView x:Name="NavigationView_Root" IsPaneOpen="False"
    SelectionChanged="NavigationView_SelectionChanged">
    <ui:NavigationView.MenuItems>
        <ui:NavigationViewItem x:Name="NavigationViewItem_Home" Content="Home">
            <ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
                <ui:FontIcon Icon="{x:Static ui:SegoeFluentIcons.Home}"/>
            </ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
        </ui:NavigationViewItem>
        <ui:NavigationViewItem x:Name="NavigationViewItem_Apps" Content="Apps">
            <ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
                <ui:FontIcon Icon="{x:Static ui:SegoeFluentIcons.OEM}"/>
            </ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
        </ui:NavigationViewItem>
        <ui:NavigationViewItem x:Name="NavigationViewItem_Games" Content="Games">
            <ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
                <ui:FontIcon Icon="{x:Static ui:SegoeFluentIcons.Game}"/>
            </ui:NavigationViewItem.Icon>
        </ui:NavigationViewItem>
    </ui:NavigationView.MenuItems>
    <ui:Frame x:Name="Frame_Main"/>
</ui:NavigationView>

TreeView.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
TreeView.description: 树形视图控件，支持数据绑定和模板选择器。

snippets.title: 基本 TreeView (内联项)
snippets.code:
<TreeView x:Name="sampleTreeView" MinWidth="345" MaxHeight="400"
    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Top">
    <TreeViewItem Header="Work Documents" IsExpanded="True">
        <TreeViewItem Header="XYZ Functional Spec" />
        <TreeViewItem Header="Feature Schedule" />
    </TreeViewItem>
    <TreeViewItem Header="Personal Documents" IsExpanded="True">
        <TreeViewItem Header="Home Remodel" IsExpanded="True">
            <TreeViewItem Header="Contractor Contact Info" />
            <TreeViewItem Header="Paint Color Scheme" />
        </TreeViewItem>
    </TreeViewItem>
</TreeView>

snippets.title: 数据绑定 TreeView
snippets.code:
<TreeView x:Name="TreeView1" MinWidth="345" MaxHeight="400"
    ItemsSource="{Binding}">
    <TreeView.ItemContainerStyle>
        <Style BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Static ui:ThemeKeys.DefaultTreeViewItemStyleKey}}" TargetType="TreeViewItem">
            <Setter Property="IsExpanded" Value="True" />
        </Style>
    </TreeView.ItemContainerStyle>
    <TreeView.ItemTemplate>
        <HierarchicalDataTemplate ItemsSource="{Binding Children}">
            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" />
        </HierarchicalDataTemplate>
    </TreeView.ItemTemplate>
</TreeView>

snippets.title: 带 FontIcon 的 TreeView 模板
snippets.code:
<DataTemplate x:Key="FileTemplate">
    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
        <ui:FontIcon Icon="{x:Static ui:SegoeFluentIcons.Document}" FontSize="20"/>
        <TextBlock Margin="0,0,10,0" />
        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" />
    </StackPanel>
</DataTemplate>

ListView.namespace: (原生 WPF, 自动应用 Modern 样式)
ListView.description: 列表视图控件，支持数据绑定、分组、选择模式等。

snippets.title: 基本 ListView
snippets.code:
<ListView x:Name="listView1"
    ItemsSource="{Binding}"
    SelectionMode="Single"
    VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling" />

snippets.title: 带数据模板的 ListView
snippets.code:
<DataTemplate x:Key="ContactListViewTemplate">
    <Grid>
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="*" />
            <RowDefinition Height="*" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
        <Ellipse Grid.RowSpan="2" Width="32" Height="32" Margin="6"
            HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Fill="Gray" />
        <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Margin="12,6,0,0"
            Style="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}"
            Text="{Binding Name, Mode=OneTime}" />
        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" Margin="12,0,0,6"
            Style="{StaticResource BodyTextBlockStyle}"
            Text="{Binding Company, Mode=OneTime}" />
    </Grid>
</DataTemplate>

SettingsCard.description: 设置卡片控件，用于创建 Windows 11 风格的设置页面。支持 Header、Description、HeaderIcon、Content 和点击功能。

snippets.title: 基本 SettingsCard
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsCard x:Name="settingsCard"
    Description="This is a default card, with the Header, HeaderIcon, Description and Content set."
    Header="This is the Header">
    <ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
    <ComboBox SelectedIndex="0">
        <ComboBoxItem>Option 1</ComboBoxItem>
        <ComboBoxItem>Option 2</ComboBoxItem>
        <ComboBoxItem>Option 3</ComboBoxItem>
    </ComboBox>
</ui:SettingsCard>

snippets.title: 带图片图标的 SettingsCard
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsCard Description="You can use a FontIcon, SymbolIcon or BitmapIcon to set the cards HeaderIcon."
    Header="Icon options">
    <ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
        <Image Width="20" Height="20" Source="/Assets/WpfLibrary_256w.png"
               RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality"/>
    </ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
    <ui:ToggleSwitch />
</ui:SettingsCard>

snippets.title: 可点击的 SettingsCard
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsCard Click="OnCardClicked"
    Description="A SettingsCard can be made clickable and you can leverage the Command property or Click event."
    Header="A clickable SettingsCard" IsClickEnabled="True">
    <ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
    <ui:SettingsCard.ActionIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsCard.ActionIcon>
</ui:SettingsCard>

snippets.title: 隐藏操作图标的 SettingsCard
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsCard Click="OnCardClicked"
    IsActionIconVisible="False" IsClickEnabled="True"
    Header="Hiding the ActionIcon">
    <ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
</ui:SettingsCard>

SettingsExpander.description: 设置展开器控件，可包含多个 SettingsCard 作为子项。支持 ItemsSource 数据绑定。

snippets.title: 基本 SettingsExpander
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsExpander x:Name="settingsCard"
    VerticalAlignment="Top"
    Description="The SettingsExpander has the same properties as a Card."
    Header="SettingsExpander"
    IsExpanded="True">
    <ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
    <ComboBox SelectedIndex="0">
        <ComboBoxItem>Option 1</ComboBoxItem>
        <ComboBoxItem>Option 2</ComboBoxItem>
    </ComboBox>
    <ui:SettingsExpander.Items>
        <ui:SettingsCard Header="A basic SettingsCard within an SettingsExpander">
            <Button Content="Button" />
        </ui:SettingsCard>
        <ui:SettingsCard Description="SettingsCard within an Expander can be made clickable too!"
            Header="This item can be clicked"
            IsClickEnabled="True" />
        <ui:SettingsCard ContentAlignment="Left">
            <CheckBox Content="Here the ContentAlignment is set to Left." />
        </ui:SettingsCard>
    </ui:SettingsExpander.Items>
</ui:SettingsExpander>

snippets.title: 带 ItemsSource 的 SettingsExpander
snippets.code:
<ui:SettingsExpander Description="The SettingsExpander can use ItemsSource to define its Items."
    Header="Settings Expander with ItemsSource"
    ItemsSource="{Binding MyDataSet}">
    <ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
        <ui:FontIcon Glyph=""/>
    </ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
    <ui:SettingsExpander.ItemTemplate>
        <DataTemplate>
            <ui:SettingsCard Description="{Binding Info}"
                Header="{Binding Name}">
                <ui:HyperlinkButton Content="{Binding LinkDescription}"
                    NavigateUri="{Binding Url}" />
            </ui:SettingsCard>
        </DataTemplate>
    </ui:SettingsExpander.ItemTemplate>

snippets.title: 完整设置页面布局
snippets.code:
<ScrollViewer Padding="20,0">
    <FrameworkElement.Resources>
        <sys:Double x:Key="SettingsCardSpacing">4</sys:Double>
        <Style x:Key="SettingsSectionHeaderTextBlockStyle"
            BasedOn="{StaticResource BodyStrongTextBlockStyle}"
            TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Style.Setters>
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="1,30,0,6" />

    </FrameworkElement.Resources>
    <Grid>
        <ikw:SimpleStackPanel MaxWidth="1000" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
            Spacing="{StaticResource SettingsCardSpacing}">
            <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SettingsSectionHeaderTextBlockStyle}" Text="Section 1" />
            <ui:SettingsCard Description="This is a default card"
                Header="This is the Header">
                <ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
                    <ui:FontIcon Glyph="" />
                </ui:SettingsCard.HeaderIcon>
                <ui:ToggleSwitch IsOn="True" />
            </ui:SettingsCard>
            <ui:SettingsExpander Description="The SettingsExpander"
                Header="SettingsExpander">
                <ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
                    <ui:FontIcon Glyph="" />
                </ui:SettingsExpander.HeaderIcon>
                <Button Content="Content" Style="{StaticResource AccentButtonStyle}" />
                <ui:SettingsExpander.Items>
                    <ui:SettingsCard Header="A basic SettingsCard">
                        <Button Content="Button" />
                    </ui:SettingsCard>
                </ui:SettingsExpander.Items>
            </ui:SettingsExpander>
        </ikw:SimpleStackPanel>
    </Grid>
</ScrollViewer>

ThemeResources.description: 主题资源控件，用于在 App.xaml 中配置主题系统，支持 Light/Dark/HighContrast 主题字典。

snippets.title: 基本主题资源配置
snippets.code:
<ui:ThemeResources>
    <ui:ThemeResources.ThemeDictionaries>
        <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Light" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="Light">
            <!-- 浅色主题资源 -->
        </ResourceDictionary>
        <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Dark" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="Dark">
            <!-- 深色主题资源 -->
        </ResourceDictionary>
        <ResourceDictionary x:Key="HighContrast" ui:ThemeDictionary.Key="HighContrast">
            <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                <ResourceDictionary Source="/Themes/HighContrast.xaml" />
            </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
        </ResourceDictionary>
    </ui:ThemeResources.ThemeDictionaries>
</ui:ThemeResources>

snippets.title: 使用 ThemeKeys 引用主题资源
snippets.code:
<Button Content="Accent button" Style="{DynamicResource {x:Static ui:ThemeKeys.AccentButtonStyleKey}}" />

<!-- 引用主题画刷 -->
<SolidColorBrush x:Key="MyBrush" Color="{DynamicResource {x:Static ui:ThemeKeys.SystemAccentColorKey}}" />

snippets.title: 使用 HasThemeResources 创建主题相关资源
snippets.code:
<TabControl ui:ThemeManager.HasThemeResources="True">
    <TabControl.Resources>
        <ui:ResourceDictionaryEx>
            <ui:ResourceDictionaryEx.ThemeDictionaries>
                <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Light">
                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="TabViewBackground" Color="{DynamicResource SystemAccentColorLight2}" />
                </ResourceDictionary>
                <ResourceDictionary x:Key="Dark">
                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="TabViewBackground" Color="{DynamicResource SystemAccentColorDark2}" />
                </ResourceDictionary>
            </ui:ResourceDictionaryEx.ThemeDictionaries>
        </ui:ResourceDictionaryEx>
    </TabControl.Resources>
</TabControl>
